jobs.title: Service Operations Manager
jobs.location: Reading, Berkshire, Berkshire · Portsmouth · Glasgow, Renfrewshire, Renfrewshire
jobs.description: Base Location: You'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in one of the following locations Havant, Reading or Glasgow Salary: £59,800 - £89,800 + performance-related bonus and a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family. Working Pattern: Permanent | Full Time | Flexible First options available The role The IT & OT Service Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the seamless integration and management of IT and Operational Technology (OT) services within the organisation delivered by the IT Outsource partner. This role ensures that both IT and OT services align with the strategic objectives and operational requirements of the business, delivering optimal performance, reliability, and security to maximise availability and ensure a seamless, positive user experience. The individual will act as a key liaison between internal stakeholders and external service providers, ensuring effective governance and operational oversight of the contractual performance of the Service Integrator. You will Service Integration and Management (SIAM) : Manage the operational integration of IT and OT services to current industry standard and relevant contractual agreements, ensuring cohesive and efficient operations across both domains. Outsourced and Third-Party Collaboration: Manage relationships with outsourced service providers, SSE teams and third-party partners to ensure delivery of contracted services and adherence to SLAs. Operational Oversight : Provide operational oversight of outsourced delivery partners, ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs). Major Incident Management : Support Major Incident Management, coordinating responses to incidents and ensuring timely resolution to minimise impact on business operations. You will be part of the Service Operations Duty Manager roster and on call to provide 24/7 support. IT Service Management (ITSM): Implement and maintain IT service management processes and frameworks, ensuring best practices are followed through close collaboration with Service Strategy and Service/Process Architecture. You have Understanding of both IT and OT operational environments, including how technology performance, resilience, and availability directly affect business continuity, safety, and operational outcomes. Familiarity with recognised industry standards and best practices for service operations and incident management, supporting consistent processes, effective governance, and continual service improvement. Familiarity with outsourcing and third-party service delivery models, including working with suppliers to manage performance, clarify ownership, and maintain service quality across end-to-end operations. Proficiency in ITIL principles and service management tools, with the ability to apply structured processes to incident, problem, change, request, and service performance management. Strong incident management skills, including experience acting as a key incident commander to coordinate resolver groups, manage communications, drive timely resolution, and reduce business impact during major incidents. About SSE SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030. Our Finance teams create value for all SSE business areas and play a key role in fulfilling our obligations as a FTSE100 UK-listed company. In a highly regulated and competitive environment, their experts keep us powering ahead by identifying efficiencies, providing advice and optimising our financial strategies. Flexible benefits to fit your life Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave. Work with an equal opportunity employer SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact the company careers page / 01738 275 846 to discuss how we can support you. We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry. Ready to apply? Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work. #LI-DB1 #LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant
jobs.description: About us SFG20 is the industry standard for building maintenance. Providing services and pioneering technologies that empower people to create and sustain safer buildings. Our mission is to make buildings better using our standard, software and expertise. Our vision is to become the leading authority for built environment maintenance that protects and enhances quality of life. About the role We're looking for an Implementation Consultant to join our Professional Services team and help customers successfully adopt our solutions. This is a highly customer-focused role where you'll work closely with organisations to understand their needs, guide them through implementation and help them achieve lasting value from their investment. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building relationships, facilitating discussions, solving problems and helping customers navigate change. While there is a technical element to the role, you'll spend much of your time working directly with customers through workshops, demonstrations, training sessions and project meetings. Your expertise will be instrumental in: Leading customer implementation projects from initiation through to successful adoption and completion. Building strong working relationships with customers and serving as a key point of contact throughout implementation projects. Facilitating discovery sessions and workshops to understand customer processes, requirements and objectives. Delivering engaging product demonstrations, training sessions and implementation workshops. Creating and managing implementation plans, milestones and project activities. Configuring the SFG20 platform to align with agreed customer requirements. Analysing, preparing and importing customer data using Microsoft Excel. Providing practical guidance and support to help customers overcome implementation challenges. Collaborating with colleagues across Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, Product and Support to ensure a seamless customer experience. Capturing requirements, documenting project activities and sharing implementation outcomes. Identifying opportunities to improve implementation processes, customer journeys and ways of working. Exploring and using new technologies, automation and AI-powered tools where they can support productivity, quality or customer outcomes Essential experience Experience implementing SaaS or B2B software solutions in a customer-facing role. Experience working with Facilities Management, Asset Management or Built Environment software solutions Knowledge of CAFM, CMMS, IWMS or similar platforms. Understanding of building maintenance, statutory compliance or asset management processes. Experience guiding customers through software implementation projects from discovery to go-live. Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into practical software solutions. Strong project coordination and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Experience using Microsoft Excel to analyse and manipulate data. Confidence facilitating meetings, workshops, demonstrations and training sessions. Strong communication, stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. Effective problem-solving and analytical thinking skills. A commitment to continuous improvement and a willingness to learn and adopt new technologies. You'll Enjoy This Role If You: Like working directly with customers and understanding what success looks like for them. Enjoy facilitating conversations, workshops and collaborative problem-solving sessions. Take a thoughtful and structured approach to managing work. Are curious and enjoy learning about new technologies and approaches. Look for opportunities to improve processes and customer experiences. Value teamwork, knowledge-sharing and collaboration. Are comfortable balancing detail with a focus on achieving outcomes. Desirable Experience Experience using CRM or project management systems. Experience using technology or AI-powered tools to improve productivity, documentation or customer outcomes. Additional Information All candidates must be able to demonstrate a pre-existing right to work and travel within the UK. We are unfortunately not able to offer sponsorship. Documentary evidence will be required. All offers are subject to satisfactory vetting and reference checks. Our Benefits: 🏖 26 days holiday + Bank holidays + buy up to 5 days 🏥 Private Medical insurance with BUPA 🏡 Remote/Hybrid first policy 💙 Employee Assistance programme with WeCare 👨‍👩‍👧 Enhanced Family Friendly Benefits 🏋️‍♂️ Gym Discounts 🚀and more! Equal opportunities for everyone Diversity and inclusion are our priorities, and we’re ensuring we have lots of support so our people can grow at SFG20 and do their best work! We embrace diversity by fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, safe and able to bring their whole self to work. We’re an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Individual Contributor)
jobs.description: Accountabilities Own the complete post-sales customer journey, including onboarding, relationship management, and ongoing support throughout the product development and delivery process. Guide customers through complex workflows by explaining production processes, managing expectations, and ensuring alignment between customer needs and internal capabilities. Act as the main point of coordination between customers, design teams, and production or sourcing partners to keep projects progressing smoothly. Monitor account progress, identify risks and bottlenecks, and proactively resolve issues before they impact timelines or customer satisfaction. Provide consultative support during product development phases, offering guidance on specifications, materials, product feedback, and technical considerations when needed. Manage a portfolio of SMB and mid-market accounts, maintaining accurate account information, tracking milestones, and monitoring customer health metrics. Identify opportunities for account expansion, including repeat orders, new product opportunities, and additional solutions aligned with customer goals. Collect customer feedback and collaborate with internal teams to improve processes, products, and overall customer experience. Maintain strong customer relationships through clear communication, proactive engagement, and a customer-first approach. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, client operations, or a similar customer-facing role. Experience managing customer relationships in e-commerce, manufacturing, technology platforms, or customized product environments is highly advantageous. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to customers with different levels of expertise. Excellent project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, timelines, and priorities simultaneously. Proactive problem-solving mindset with strong attention to detail and the ability to identify and resolve operational challenges. Commercial awareness and confidence identifying growth opportunities, upselling opportunities, and solutions that create customer value. Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot or similar tools to manage accounts, track activities, and maintain customer records. Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment with strong ownership, organization, and accountability. Startup mindset with adaptability, urgency, resilience, and willingness to take initiative. Experience with apparel development, product manufacturing, fabric sourcing, or custom production is considered a strong advantage. Comfortable working with international teams and distributed colleagues across different time zones. Benefits: Fully remote working environment with the flexibility to work from anywhere. Opportunity to join a global team and collaborate with colleagues across multiple regions. High level of ownership and autonomy in managing customer relationships and improving processes. Direct impact on customer satisfaction, retention, and business growth. Opportunity to work with innovative systems and technology-driven workflows. Continuous learning and professional development opportunities. Inclusive and collaborative culture focused on curiosity, excellence, and customer success. Support for professional growth within a fast-paced, international environment.
